evidence.quote: I need to correct something I said, and I'd rather do it at the top than bury it.

observations.why: Tina prioritizes immediate factual correction and analytical integrity over saving face or concealing error.

evidence.quote: Two weeks was conservative in a place where being conservative was cheap. One week is defensible but it has no slack in it.

observations.why: Xavier explicitly weighs conservation and safety margin (cheap slack) against defensibility.

evidence.quote: I'd rather be defensible and know where the slack isn't than conservative for a reason that turned out to be imaginary.

observations.why: Tina explicitly values grounded technical rigor and empirical accuracy over artificial buffer.

evidence.quote: Thank you for bringing it rather than letting it ride.

observations.why: Tanya expresses appreciation and reinforces the relational trust of surfacing hard corrections proactively.

mints.name: DefensibleOverPrecautionary
mints.title: defensible rather than conservative for imaginary reasons
mints.frame: Does the speaker choose demonstrable, empirically verified precision over ungrounded precautionary padding or face-saving?
